plan.rule: Each variable takes the slot of its own area nearest the mean place of all its partners across the 118 connections; one least-squares assignment per area, repeated until no variable moves; the bottom tier order is the one of 24 with the shortest total connection length.

grammar.dash_note: Dash lengths are V7 code for a 2 px line, scaled by weight / 2.

bulge.rule: Sagitta = share x chord, capped. Steps bow away from the mean of the loop stations; two-station loops and loops in a line bow to the right of travel.

tiers.full: route, V7 line code, pointing tags (sign and direction), closing bar, start ring, stations, plan
tiers.compact: route, V7 line code, a chevron for direction, closing bar, start ring, stations, plan; signs move to the caption
tiers.locator: route as a plain line, stations, plan; the caption carries everything else
